title: Dependency auditor with carousel
request: Dependency auditor. The user pastes Python requirements, one 'package==version' per line. Use ONLY this advisory list: django < 4.2.8 is vulnerable to CVE-2023-46695; requests < 2.31.0 to CVE-2023-32681; pillow < 10.0.1 to CVE-2023-4863; urllib3 < 1.26.18 to CVE-2023-45803. Package names are case-insensitive. Reply '<k> vulnerable of <n> packages' and, if k > 0, attach a carousel card with one item per vulnerable package (title = package name, subtitle = CVE id), each with a primary button 'Upgrade' whose selection is {"action":"upgrade","package":"<name>"}. If k = 0 reply 'No known vulnerabilities in <n> packages' with no card.
